name: gizza-ai/pdf-search
summary: Search a PDF for a word or phrase and list matching pages with context

tool.description: Search a PDF for a literal word or phrase and list every matching page with surrounding context. Provide url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref from a prior tool call, and a query. Options: case_sensitive (default false), whole_word (default false), context characters per side (default 60), max_matches (default 100). Each hit returns its 1-based page and a snippet with the match wrapped in «…». Searches the embedded selectable text layer only — it does not OCR scanned/image-only PDFs, and the query is literal text, not a regular expression.

url.description: Document URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

query.description: The literal word or phrase to search for. Whitespace is normalized, so a multi-word phrase still matches where the PDF split it across lines. Not a regular expression.

case_sensitive.description: Match the exact case. Default false (case-insensitive).

whole_word.description: Only match whole words (alphanumeric word boundaries on both sides), so "cat" does not match "category". Default false.

context.description: Number of characters of surrounding context to show on each side of a match. Default 60.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of match snippets to return. total_matches still counts every occurrence and truncated flags when the list is capped. Default 100.
